captions.detailed: A service-panel bracket featuring a flat, dark grey rectangular backplate. Attached to the backplate is a vertical cylindrical spine with two rotating dark blue branch arms. Each branch arm terminates in a rectangular orange end plate holding a small horizontal steel pin. The two branch arms articulate independently via revolute joints around the vertical central spine.
captions.instruction: Create a service-panel two-branch bracket with a flat rectangular backplate. It should feature a vertical cylindrical spine supporting two independent dark blue branch arms that can rotate via revolute joints, each ending in a rectangular orange plate with a horizontal pin.
captions.factory: Construct a flat rectangular Box for the backplate. Create a vertical Cylinder for the central spine, supported by small rectangular mounting blocks. Model two separate branch arms using Box primitives for the arms, Box primitives for the orange end plates, and Cylinder primitives for the horizontal pins. Define two independent revolute joints (one for each branch arm) rotating around the vertical axis of the central cylinder.
